hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q planemo || exit 0; f=$(find /mnt/ssd/galaxy_packages -maxdepth 2 \( -name tool_test_output.html -o -name tool_test_output.json -o -name shed_upload.tar.gz \) -print -delete 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] && jq -cn --arg f "$f" '{systemMessage:("removed stray planemo artifacts: " + ($f|gsub("\n";", ")))}'; exit 0
